about: TemperatureConverter's words. fahrenheit and celsius: case-insensitive regex fragments naming the scale in full (the letters F and C and the degree signs are in the code); Japanese writes the one-character ℃ ('200℃に予熱'). degrees: regex fragments for the word between a number and its scale ('180 degrees C'), case-sensitive. A bare '180度' names no scale, so it stays as written.
